description: At Pragjyotishpur University's Diksharambha ceremony, Ranoj Pegu urged new students to build skills in AI and emerging technologies. The message focused on employability, adaptability and the university's expanding academic offerings.
body_lead: Assam Education Minister urges Pragjyotishpur University students to embrace AI, emerging technologies At Pragjyotishpur University's Diksharambha ceremony, Ranoj Pegu urged new students to build skills in AI and emerging technologies. The message focused on employability, adaptability and the university's expanding academic offerings.
